prompts.text: Never have I ever eaten an entire pizza by myself.
Never have I ever stayed awake for more than 24 hours.
Never have I ever laughed so hard I cried.
Never have I ever pretended to know a song and completely made up the words.
Never have I ever binged an entire TV season in one day.
Never have I ever worn pajamas all day.
Never have I ever eaten food that fell on the floor.
Never have I ever re-used a cup without washing it.
Never have I ever talked to myself in public without realizing it.
Never have I ever forgotten someone's name right after being introduced.
Never have I ever read the end of a book before finishing it.
Never have I ever accidentally called a teacher 'mom' or 'dad'.
Never have I ever played video games for more than 8 hours straight.
Never have I ever won a bet.
Never have I ever danced in public alone.
Never have I ever snuck food into a cinema.
Never have I ever gotten completely lost in a city I know.
Never have I ever bought something just because it was on sale.
Never have I ever sent a voice message accidentally.
Never have I ever skipped brushing my teeth before bed.
Never have I ever stalked an ex on social media after a breakup.
Never have I ever been caught in a lie and made it worse with another lie.
Never have I ever dramatically pretended not to see someone in public.
Never have I ever cried watching a commercial.
Never have I ever Googled myself.
Never have I ever faked being busy to avoid someone.
Never have I ever liked my own post from a second account.
Never have I ever eavesdropped on a conversation not meant for me.
Never have I ever bought something expensive on impulse and regretted it.
Never have I ever unfriended someone and hoped they would not notice.
Never have I ever laughed at something I should not have.
Never have I ever taken credit for someone else's work.
Never have I ever secretly judged someone based on their music taste.
Never have I ever rehearsed a conversation in my head before having it.
Never have I ever pretended to fall asleep to avoid a conversation.
Never have I ever given a fake number to someone.
Never have I ever misread a situation and thought someone liked me back.
Never have I ever sent a screenshot to the person it was about.
Never have I ever started a group chat and then not participated.
Never have I ever deleted a comment immediately after posting it.
Never have I ever been on a date with more than one person in the same week.
Never have I ever kissed someone whose last name I did not know.
Never have I ever developed feelings for my best friend.
Never have I ever been attracted to someone in this room.
Never have I ever started a flirty conversation and then chickened out.
Never have I ever been rejected and completely played it off like I was joking.
Never have I ever sent a risky message at 2 AM and regretted it in the morning.
Never have I ever kept talking to someone just because the attention felt nice.
Never have I ever made up a story to impress someone I liked.
Never have I ever gone back to an ex I swore I was done with.
Never have I ever told someone I loved them when I was not sure I meant it.
Never have I ever stayed in a relationship I knew was not working just for comfort.
Never have I ever had a dramatic falling out with a best friend over someone we both liked.
Never have I ever used my looks to get out of trouble.
Never have I ever slid into someone's DMs on a whim.
Never have I ever cried after a breakup I initiated.
Never have I ever been jealous of someone I should not have been jealous of.
Never have I ever played hard to get and overdone it.
Never have I ever confessed feelings in a very embarrassing way.
Never have I ever been tempted to read a partner's phone.
